'''[[Accepted]]''' are those who have been partially trained but not yet raised to the rank of [[Aes Sedai]]. While they have certain privileges that are not available to them as [[novice]]s, their studies are even harder, and they are required to teach [[novice]] classes as well. They may not leave [[Tar Valon]] unless they are sent away, or with explicit permission.

This list indexes all characters who have ever reached the rank of accepted without becoming Aes Sedai, whether by being Accepted at the dawn of the [[Fourth Age]], by failing their test for the shawl, or by dying while Accepted.

Full Aes Sedai sisters are not listed in this index, though they were once Accepted themselves. Their status as a full sister supersedes the Accepted category.  Likewise, Accepted are not listed with the Novice tag, as their status supersedes the lower category.
